purpose: One predefined v3 experiment after v2 diagnosis, no sweep
development: 5 original test sources previously inspected; no longer independent tests
fresh: 8 new AI-created scenarios; frozen before v3 training; no output feedback or retuning; not external independent human evaluation
fact_gate: No documented material contradiction on the fresh set, with key conditions retained; ambiguous cases explicitly reported
style_gate: Blind human preference; zero votes cannot prove style improvement
selection: Two epochs only, minimum original validation token loss; no evaluation-based weight selection
inference: Same v3 prompt, pinned base, greedy decoding, max 384 tokens, base vs reloaded v3
